Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Ananya - 12 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Sunita - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Vikram - 39 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Sunita, Vikram and Ananya stand near him.]

Vikram: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil reads a storybook.]

Nikhil: "What next?"

[Nikhil studies for his exam.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

[Nikhil does his homework at the table.]

Sunita: "Well done!"

[Nikhil talks to his father on the phone.]

Nikhil: "Let's see."

[Nikhil's phone rings and he answers it.]

Ananya: "Careful!"

[Nikhil types on his laptop.]

Nikhil (softly): "What next?"

[Nikhil watches cartoons on TV.]

Ananya: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Ananya and Sunita stand near him.]

Nikhil: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil goes jogging in the park.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

[Nikhil throws the ball to Mother.]

Sunita: "Careful!"

[Ananya skips rope.]

Sunita: "Nikhil, look at this."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Vikram: "And then?"

[Nikhil takes the bag from Mother.]

Nikhil (softly): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Nikhil bursts out laughing.]

Vikram: "How beautiful!"

[Nikhil helps Mother get up.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Nikhil (excited): "Hmm, I see."

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Nikhil stands in the bedroom. Sunita, Ananya and Vikram stand near him.]

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil yawns loudly.]

Nikhil (surprised): "That's great!"

[Nikhil stretches his arms above his head.]

Nikhil: "That was such a fun day!"
